After Debbie Webster ’s ( Sue Devaney ) chat with Kit Green (Jacob Roberts), Carl became the prime suspect in Eva’s attack and the target of Ben Driscoll’s (Aaron McCusker) wrath. Little did any of them know, Sam Blakeman (Jude Riordan) was battling with his guilt as the actual culprit, and when he visited Eva in hospital, she suddenly remembered that he had pushed her . Elsewhere, Lucy Parkinson (Anya Dewin) continued to cause trouble for Tim Metcalfe (Joe Duttine) when she stole money from his wallet to go out with her friends and failed to show any remorse. Meanwhile, Jodie faked a cancelled date to spend time with David Platt (Jack P Shepherd) as part of her scheme to get revenge on sister Shona Platt (Julia Goulding), but she faced a hurdle in the form of Doug Ramsey (Steve Evets). Experts agree that lowering blood pressure reduces the risk of heart attack and stroke. For World Heart Day, Dr. Dmitry Yaranov, a cardiologist and an AstraZeneca brand partner, joins "CBS Mornings" to talk about the blood pressure hormone, aldosterone, that could be an underlying factor in keeping blood pressure high. Dr. Yaranov also talks about a new FDA-approved prescription medicine called BAXFENDY® (baxdrostat) that lowers blood pressure by directly targeting aldosterone. (Sponsored by AstraZeneca). IMPORTANT PRODUCT INFORMATION A prescription medicine used along with other blood pressure medicines to treat high blood pressure (hypertension) in adults whose blood pressure is not well controlled with other medicines. Can cause increased potassium (hyperkalemia) and decreased sodium (hyponatremia) levels in your blood. Tell your healthcare provider if you have high potassium, kidney problems or diabetes. items.text: The real reason your Mounjaro has stopped working: DR PHILIPPA KAYE reveals diet supplement that can boost your jabs, the part of the body you MUST inject and why it may be time to switch to a different weight loss drug
items.article: Weight-loss injections are some of the most revolutionary medicines in modern times - but they are not perfect. By DR PHILIPPA KAYE, GP, AUTHOR AND CAMPAIGNER Published: 12:09, 28 April 2026 | Updated: 12:04, 8 May 2026 Weight-loss injections are some of the most revolutionary medicines in modern times – but they are not perfect. Millions of Britons and Americans now take Mounjaro and Wegovy, which can help obese patients lose as much as a fifth of their body weight in a year. The data shows that the majority of these patients are women who pay for the appetite-suppressing jabs through private clinics. For any woman above a certain age this will hardly come as a shock – we are all too familiar with the pressure to remain thin, even as the demands of mid-life accumulate. For patients, these drugs can be life-changing, allowing them to lose more weight than they ever thought possible.

items.article: Journalist Fiona Moss swapped her inner city apartment for ten acres of the Scottish highlands to fulfil a life long dream...raising Highland cattle. Published: 17:30, 10 September 2026 | Updated: 17:30, 10 September 2026 Try as she might, journalist Fiona Ross has never been able to find any trace of Highland roots in her family tree. Despite this, she loves the Scottish Highlands in a way that is ‘raw, primeval, fundamental.’ Looking over to Ben More at sunset on the Isle of Mull With their three children on the cusp of adulthood, she and her husband Neil decided to sell their flat in the centre of Glasgow and buy ten acres of farmland in the west of Scotland, where they could fulfil their long-held dream of raising Highland cattle. In short order they had bought three calves, ‘doe-eyed, curly-haired lassies’, who were so tame they enjoyed being groomed with a comb and having their cheeks tickled.
